title: Three-dimensional and dynamic assessment of digital lymphatic vessels using photoacoustic imaging

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Three-dimensional and dynamic assessment of digital lymphatic vessels using photoacoustic imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】We evaluated whether photoacoustic lymphangiography (PAL) could depict three-dimensional anatomy and motion-related deformation in vivo.

evidence.text: We evaluated whether photoacoustic lymphangiography (PAL) could depict three-dimensional anatomy and motion-related deformation in vivo.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Three-dimensional and dynamic assessment of digital lymphatic vessels using photoacoustic imaging》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Two healthy volunteers and one patient with secondary upper-extremity lymphedema underwent fingertip indocyanine green injection, near-infrared fluorescence imaging, and static and dynamic PAL.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】In the patient, PAL visualized vessels beneath dermal backflow that appeared more irregular and showed frequent short-segment tortuosity, and guided lymphaticovenular anastomosis.

evidence.text: Two healthy volunteers and one patient with secondary upper-extremity lymphedema underwent fingertip indocyanine green injection, near-infrared fluorescence imaging, and static and dynamic PAL.
In the patient, PAL visualized vessels beneath dermal backflow that appeared more irregular and showed frequent short-segment tortuosity, and guided lymphaticovenular anastomosis.
